description: This file defines the class 'FormatWithPurgeTime' which implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface to provide a formatted DateTime value, specifically returning the current DateTime. It uses a trait for DateTime helper functions and is part of the 'OrangeHRM' human resource management system, within the maintenance purge strategy formatting module.

classes.name: FormatWithPurgeTime
classes.description: Implements ValueFormatter to return the current DateTime for formatting purposes in purge strategy.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Returns the current DateTime using the DateTimeHelperTrait.
